name: The Sea's Lost Daughter
source: On a summer trip to a beach house with your friends, an accident sends you crashing into the ocean! When you wake up, you discover that you're a mermaid! Can you use the power of love to overthrow the evil king and save your true home in the sea?
translation: 夏天和朋友去海滨别墅旅行时，一场意外让你坠入大海！当你醒来时，你发现自己是一条美人鱼！你能用爱的力量打倒邪恶的国王，拯救你真正的海上家园吗？
